The home of authentic shawarma

Borsciq Bistro began with a simple idea: a table where good food and slow moments belong together. Our kitchen cooks with seasonal produce, olive-forward flavours and generous hospitality, whether it is a quiet lunch or a long evening with friends.

Every plate is prepared to order, every guest is greeted like a regular.
